    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey

GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey

GROUP BY
    n1.n_name,

WITH german_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
),
german_parts AS (
    SELECT
        ps.ps_partkey,
        SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS value
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    gp.ps_partkey,
    gp.value
FROM german_parts gp
JOIN german_total g ON gp.value > 0.0001 * g.total_value
ORDER BY gp.value DESC

        MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'

WITH min_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ps.ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
      AND p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN min_costs mc ON ps.ps_partkey = mc.ps_partkey
WHERE ps.ps_supplycost = mc.min_cost
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100

FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey

    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey

WITH min_costs AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.ps_suppkey,
    ps.ps_partkey,
    ps.ps_supplycost
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost
  HAVING ps.ps_supplycost = (
    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost)

WITH part_min_costs AS (
    SELECT 
        ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp ps

    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
      AND p.p_size = 15
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    GROUP BY ps_partkey
)
SELECT 
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,

JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey

WHERE ps.ps_supplycost = mc.min_cost
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name ASC, s.s_name ASC, p.p_partkey ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

FROM lineitem

    o.o_orderkey,

    l.l_orderkey
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
    AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
),
different_supplier_items AS (
  SELECT 
    l1.l_orderkey,

  WHERE l1.l_suppkey != l2.l_suppkey
)
SELECT 
  sl.s_name,
  COUNT(sl.l_orderkey) AS numwait

ORDER BY numwait DESC, sl.s_name ASC

SELECT
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    YEAR(l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n1 ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN
    nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
    AND (n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')
    OR (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
GROUP BY
    n1.n_name, n2.n_name, YEAR(l.l_shipdate)
ORDER BY
    n1.n_name, n2.n_name, l_year
